svg.text: Chaining small steps: e on the real line, π and −1 round the wall (mult-add, wall at −1)
n steps of 1/n on the real line
n steps of iπ/n turn round the wall
• The same rule, a ∘ b = a + b + ab, makes
both constants. Only the direction of the
• Real steps compound: 1/n, n times → e − 1.
• Imaginary steps turn about the wall −1:
iπ/n, n times → −2, so the lift
• π is how far you go round the wall to
reach the far side; 2π brings you home.
All of this is Euler (1748). The wall reading
is ours, from the complex-analysis and pi pages.
